sources.title: Structured interview source containing URL-to-JSON parsing prompt
Node.js URL API documentation (WHATWG URL and URLSearchParams)
URL-to-JSON deterministic and generated validation program

claims.text: The preserved source asks for a URL string to be parsed into JSON while considering protocol, domain, path and query-parameter special cases; the exact output schema, absolute-only policy and repeated-key array representation are candidate contracts.
Node.js exposes the WHATWG URL API with separate hostname, port, pathname and URLSearchParams accessors; URLSearchParams provides structured iteration over query parameters.

The checked-in validator covers non-default/default ports, IPv6, repeated and empty query values, plus decoding, opaque custom scheme, percent-encoded pathname, __proto__ query key, relative-input rejection and 5000 generated absolute URLs.
